svg.title: Solver time of every backend tuple, hhcpu-4node-q1e6
svg.desc: Horizontal bars of median solver time on a log scale for every validated build, MPI rank, OpenMP thread, and GPU tuple on hhcpu-4node-q1e6 at 1000000 particles per hour, fastest at the top, labelled with the median and the speedup over the serial build. Computational diagnostic of measured execution; no confidence intervals.
